summary.en: Conan and the Detective Boys were hiking in the forest and were going to visit a lighthouse when the storm bursted. They decided to hide under a the solar panels of a greenhouse and have been spotted by the greenhouse's manager who brought them to the nearby Otaguro mansion. They were welcomed by Saburo and Yoshimoto, the maid. They were then informed about the head of the family, Otaguro, who have had early encounters of a ghost that appeared like a yellow glowing light. Just after, the mysterious glowing light in question appeared and frightened the Detective Boys and it was interrupted by the arrival of Hideto Amemiya who led them visit his lab and explained them the past accident of the late Mrs. Otaguro. Victim: Chieko Otaguro Cause of death: Falling from the cliff Victim: Nobuteru Otaguro Suspects: Saburo Yoshimoto, Hana Yoshimoto, and Hideto Amemiya
